pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away through contours that are too closed, too dark and too even. In the lessons, heavy unbroken lines run around the whole form and around inner parts such as stickers, panels and rims, where real cards let edges break and get lost on the lit side. Sharpness is also spread evenly instead of gathering at the focus. Background surfaces such as wood grain, tiles and foliage pick up too many hard lines, and small repeated detail or uniform surface grain inflates edge density. On this vector the differences are often slight, so most calls here are low-confidence.
